messages:
maria_lee: Quick heads-up: SDK PR #482 (https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/482) depends on an api-proto change in the api repo. console PR is currently blocked. Can SDK and API owners triage? TL;DR: proto field rename `user_context` -> `session_context` required.

samir: @kevin can you confirm if the API change is safe for Dedicated? Breaking change but it's just a rename with default fallback.

kevin: I can take the proto PR. I'll open api#300 to do the rename + compatibility shim. ETA today EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ashley: Console PR #211 will need an update to the mapping layer once proto lands. If Kevin pushes the shim, I can patch console after merge; prefer to coordinate canary.

maria_lee: Sounds good. Priority is to avoid blocking SDK release—if shim buys us time we can merge SDK with feature flag. @samir can you approve SDK with flag?

samir: I can review now. Quick question: is runtime's helm chart affected? The change is cross-repo but shouldn't touch runtime config.

kevin: No helm changes needed. Runtime only sees serialized messages. I'll add proto shim and CI test that deserializes both fields.

ci-bot: sdk#482 build passed on linux, failed on mac (flake). Retrying...

ashley: Also flagging ops: need to run migration for any stored user contexts? @devops

devops: We'll add a small migration script if needed, prefer to run as part of the canary window. Ping me when proto PR merged.

maria_lee: Plan: Kevin opens api#300 now, adds compatibility shim + test. CI green -> merge. Samir approves SDK#482 behind feature flag -> merge. Ashley patches console#211 to read new field with fallback -> merge. Devops schedules canary. I'll post a merge window time by EOD. :white_check_mark:

samir: reviewing SDK now, will leave comments inline.

kevin: api#300 opened https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/300 — small proto change + shim. PTAL @maria_lee @samir

maria_lee: LGTM, thanks. I'll watch the canary.
